additional_sources_needed: GCS 66499.41(a)(8), for the exact demolition-protection test. Chaptered text of the statute on leginfo.legislature.ca.gov. It cannot be captured as evidence until a statute source type exists; do not capture it as an adopted_ordinance.
Los Angeles Housing Department records for RSO status, covenants, and Ellis Act withdrawals.
LADBS permit records for the five-year look-back.
candidate_pinpoint: Memo Part I, Demolition Protections, page 3 (GCS 66499.41(a)(8))
candidate_excerpt: Specifically, a project may not be approved if it would require the demolition or alteration of any of the following types of housing:
locate_in_source: Located in shra-2025-10-28: Part I, Demolition Protections, pages 3-4 (GCS 66499.41(a)(8), the SB 1123 no-separation rule, and the Ellis Act bar). Vacancy is FAQ Q.1, page 12, and stays in la_shra.vacant-site-definition.
question_for_human_reviewer: The memo (pages 3-4) bars a project that would demolish or alter covenant-restricted, rent-controlled (including RSO), or recently tenant-occupied housing, and bars sites with an Ellis Act withdrawal within 15 years of the application. Do you agree that the Ellis Act bar can be encoded from a dated LAHD record, that the demolition protections must stay judgment whenever protected housing is present because they depend on the project, and that occupancy-history (free text) and existing-structures (a count) should be replaced by the structured facts proposed? How should look-back periods that run from the application date be measured in a screen that has no application?

proposed_controlled_interpretation.controlled_values_required: occupancy-history is free text and cannot drive a rule. existing-structures counts any structure and cannot express protected housing. Proposed: residential-use-within-5-years (yes/no), affordability-covenant-recorded (yes/no), rso-status (existing), and ellis-act-withdrawal-date (a date or none), each human-recorded from the record named.
proposed_controlled_interpretation.narrowing_note: Split into la_shra.protected-housing-demolition, la_shra.ellis-act-withdrawal, and la_shra.existing-units-not-separated (see candidate_components). Vacancy stays professional under la_shra.vacant-site-definition.
proposed_controlled_interpretation.predicate_shape_if_reviewer_agrees: Ellis Act: a withdrawal within 15 years before the application -> disqualifying_per_source; none in a reviewed LAHD record -> consistent_with_source. Demolition protections: no housing within the look-back (reviewed) -> consistent_with_source; protected housing present -> requires_judgment. No-separation rule: project design, not screened.
must_remain_unresolved_when: occupancy history exists only as free text
the look-back period cannot be measured because no application date is recorded
protected housing is present and the project's demolition or alteration is unknown
structure, occupancy, RSO, or covenant records conflict
proposed_controlled_interpretation.zimas_conflict_risk: Low to medium. The memo points to the ZIMAS eligibility checklist for the Ellis Act bar (page 4); ZIMAS stays observation-only unless the reviewer designates the LAHD record. A parcel display alone does not show occupancy history.

candidate_components.label: No demolition or alteration of covenant-restricted, rent-controlled, or recently tenant-occupied housing
candidate_components.pinpoint: Memo Part I, Demolition Protections, page 3 (GCS 66499.41(a)(8))

excerpts.text: Specifically, a project may not be approved if it would require the demolition or alteration of any of the following types of housing:
2) Housing subject to any form of rent or sales price control imposed by a local public entity’s valid exercise of its police power (e.g., the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)); or
3) Housing that has been occupied by a tenant within the five years prior to the application date, including, including housing that has been demolished or that tenants have vacated.

new_facts_needed: residential-use-within-5-years: yes/no, human-recorded from LADBS and LAHD records for the five years before a recorded application date, including demolished or vacated housing.
affordability-covenant-recorded: yes/no from the recorded covenant.
candidate_components.controlled_value_encoding: A structured yes/no for housing within the look-back, plus rso-status and a covenant flag.
candidate_components.proposed_rule_if_reviewer_agrees: residential-use-within-5-years recorded false from a reviewed record and no covenant -> consistent_with_source. Any protected housing now or within five years -> requires_judgment, because the bar applies only if the project would demolish or alter it. Never disqualifying_per_source from parcel facts alone.
judgment_or_ambiguity: The five-year look-back runs from the application date, which a parcel screen does not have.
The bar turns on project design; AB 130 remainder parcels can retain existing housing (FAQ Q.23).
Item 3 prints 'including, including'; read GCS 66499.41(a)(8) for the exact test.
HCA and RPO replacement and the No Net Loss Declaration (page 4) are conditions, not bars.

candidate_components.label: No Ellis Act withdrawal of units on the parcel within 15 years of the application
candidate_components.pinpoint: Memo Part I, Demolition Protections, page 4

excerpts.text: In addition, the development may not be located on parcels where an Ellis Act withdrawal of units has occurred within 15 years of the application (see the ZIMAS eligibility checklist noted above).

new_facts_needed: ellis-act-withdrawal-date: the date of the most recent Ellis Act withdrawal for the parcel, or none, human-recorded from the Los Angeles Housing Department record.
candidate_components.controlled_value_encoding: An ISO date or an explicit none from the LAHD record. A failed lookup is unknown, not none.
candidate_components.proposed_rule_if_reviewer_agrees: Withdrawal within 15 years before the application date -> disqualifying_per_source; none in a reviewed LAHD record, or the latest withdrawal more than 15 years before -> consistent_with_source; not retrieved -> unknown.
judgment_or_ambiguity: Measured from the application; the reviewer must decide whether the screen's as_of date may stand in.
Which Ellis Act event sets the date (notice filing or effective withdrawal) is not stated.

candidate_components.label: Existing dwelling units may not be legally separated by the SHRA subdivision
candidate_components.pinpoint: Memo Part I, Demolition Protections, page 4 (SB 1123)

excerpts.text: Pursuant to SB 1123, any existing dwelling units on the property may not be legally separated as part of a SHRA subdivision.

candidate_components.controlled_value_encoding: None at the parcel screen; this constrains the subdivision design.
judgment_or_ambiguity: A project-design condition, not a site bar: existing units do not by themselves make the site ineligible (see also FAQ Q.22 and Q.23).
